absences: Part 57 final rule: NRC proposed-rule page (updated 2026-09-14) and ANS (2026-10-22) both still describe it as proposed. No final rule and no scheduled final date found. The 2026-11-23 date traces to the May 2025 executive order's 18-month NRC overhaul deadline (search summary, Foley Hoag; not fetched), not to a Part 57 schedule. Not written as a claim.

NRC: the 2026 news-release index (fetched) lists no release after 2026-11-13; latest is 26-084 dated 2026-11-12 (NRC Streamlines Advisory Committee Role To Support Advanced Nuclear Licensing), which is before the window. No NRC Commission vote on a microreactor found after 2026-11-13.

FY2027 NDAA: House version (HR 8800) carries a microreactor provision (Harrigan amendment: Indo-Pacific transportable microreactor program; microreactor defined at 50 MWe or less). House passage was June 2026, before the window. Senate microreactor text not found. Final conference status not found.

DOE FY2027 appropriations: no House or Senate floor action or enacted bill found after June 2026. The DOE nuclear budget figure is disputed between sources ($1.53B Office of Nuclear Energy in testimony vs. a reported 9% cut); not resolved.
Army Janus: latest award news is August 2026 (up to $2.2B across five vendors). No November 2026 Army or DoD policy action found.
CNSC: no 2026 microreactor licence decision found. OPG applied in March 2026 for an operating licence for one BWRX-300 at Darlington (not a microreactor, not decided).
DOE Reactor Pilot Program: no new DOE authorization announcement dated after 2026-11-13 found. Latest milestone coverage is ANS 2026-11-02 (October milestones for Antares, Last Energy, Radiant).

Louisiana nuclear tariff (LPSC): a 20-cent monthly fee on Entergy Louisiana, Cleco and SWEPCO bills to fund SMR and microreactor early-stage studies. Reported 2026-08-13; vote postponed to 2026-09-16 per the Louisiana Illuminator summary. No docket number, filing date or outcome found. Louisiana Illuminator and newsfromthestates returned HTTP 403 on fetch. Not written as a docket.
Alaska SB 177 threshold: shipped text says 50 MW, which WNN (2023, fetched) supports. A search summary cited 20 MW; no fetchable source confirmed it. Left unresolved, not checked.

Texas HB 14 construction tranche: the $280M Advanced Nuclear Construction Reimbursement Program requires a docketed NRC application by 2026-12-01 (ANS 2026-04-09 and Utility Dive, both fetched). The shipped mechanism line omits this condition. Not written as a check because the shipped sentence is incomplete rather than contradicted; flagged for the main session.
Texas TANEO award recipients (selections were due July 2026) not found in any source.

Kentucky SB 57 was signed 2026-04-08 (outside the 90-day window). A September 2026 Kentucky signing is reported in one aggregator with conflicting dates; not verified. NJ S4849 and A5727 are already shipped in skip/dockets.json. NJ Power NJ Act signed 2026-07-13 (outside the window).

Dockets: no in-window (since 2026-08-18) state legislation, PUC order or IRP naming microreactors or SMRs was found with a verifiable docket number and filing or order date. Dockets list left empty rather than padded.

FERC EL25-49: PJM compliance filing was due 60 days after the 2026-06-18 order (about 2026-08-17). Whether PJM filed, and any later FERC action, not found. The FERC order PDF (ferc.gov) and the Willkie memo returned binary content on fetch.
Not checked: 45Y/48E credits, Price-Anderson, and the ADVANCE Act fee rate (the fee clause is in recently-checked and was skipped). Price-Anderson and 45Y/48E have no shipped row in policy.json.
Web leads: the ANS INL/Purdue construction-demonstration item and the NRC bridge-workshop item are dated before 2026-11-13 and are outside this agent's lane. Not checked.
Recently-checked rows (Texas Backup Power Package; NRC licensing fee clause) were not re-checked, as instructed.
